RecoveryRequired routes to recovery and arms ZERO db-bound work()

post-arming terminal failure refuses in-process candidate publication()

testcase.name: suspend preflight - RecoveryCompleted peeks the live schema too()
low-ram device skips the planner but keeps cleanup()
suspend preflight - restore success skips scenario 2 but still arms()
suspend preflight - no-op runs scenario 2 strictly after scenario 1, then arms()
RecoveryCompleted peeks the live schema - the rollback replaced the file out of process()
route-to-recovery decision skips the planner but keeps cleanup and observer arming()
a terminal recovery route SEALS worker admission - both scenarios()
the CANDIDATE preflight never seals - its abort leaves a healthy generation serving()
suspend preflight - RecoveryRequired routes to recovery and arms ZERO db-bound work()
scenario 1 success skips scenario 2 but still arms the chores and the observer()
an ordinary launch never seals worker admission()
